conviction_note: Two separate measurements. The findings sum to +1.6: a steady beat-and-raise pattern (recurring GP 2.7% and 3.5% above the top of the guide in Q1 and Q2), a conservative implied Q4 (about 19% growth inside the FY guide against 22-24% guided for Q3), and the strongest Census restaurant sales in 3+ years, offset by a 2027 memory and hardware cost overhang. The scaled number is (2x0.54-1)x10.5 = +0.84. p_up is held near 50 because the options carry a +22 vol-point put skew, the stock ran +11.8% over 20 days into the print, and Q1 2026's beat-and-raise was sold -14.7% on the guide. abs_move stays at about the 10.9% implied move because a Q4 implied guide and likely early 2027 color both sit on the guidance line.
bar: Company guide for Q3 2026: non-GAAP subscription+fintech (recurring) gross profit $615-625M and adjusted EBITDA $210-220M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001650164/000165016426000162/tost-20260630xexhibit991.htm, 2026-08-04). FY2026 guide: $2,325-2,355M recurring GP and $805-825M adj. EBITDA. Street revenue is about $2.01B from two agreeing sources (chartmill https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/TOST/estimates and fxempire https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/tost/earnings, 21 analysts). Street EPS is $0.25-0.26. Consensus recurring GP is unsourced; the buy side probably sits above the $625M top. print_vs_bar is measured against that guide top: about $640M expected, if the Q1/Q2 beat size repeats.
positioning_check: Short interest 34.27M shares (about 5.9% of float), 3.7 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/tost/shortinterest), down from 44.2M on 2026-06-30. Not a crowded short. Baseline: 25d skew +22.36 vol points (downside heavily paid), put/call OI 1.26, ATM IV 135%, event-implied move 10.87%. Run-up +6.47% over 5 days and +11.82% over 20 days; spot is 13% below the 52-week high. The stock rallied into the print while the option market paid for downside.

findings.finding: Toast beat the top of its own recurring gross profit guide in each 2026 quarter: Q1 $529M against $505-515M (+2.7% above top) and Q2 $595M against $565-575M (+3.5% above top). The same beat on the Q3 guide of $615-625M would print about $635-645M (22-24% growth guided, about 26-28% implied). Q2 adjusted EBITDA was $221M against $185-195M, about $10M of it a tariff refund.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 beat by $14M above the top of the guide and the stock fell -14.74% (the guide and hardware/tariff costs were blamed). Q2 2026 beat by $20M above the top and it rose +2.93%. Q4 2025 (Feb 2026) +4.55%, Q3 2025 +9.48%. Beats alone are not reliably paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: a beat of this size is the street's base case for a company that beats systematically. If the market expected no beat, the stock would not have run +11.8% into the print. What is not priced is a beat larger than about 3%.
findings.independence: Q1 actual against guide comes from separate documents: the Q1 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001650164/000165016426000113/tost-20260331xexhibit991.htm (2026-05-07) and the Feb guide https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260212058106/en/Toast-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results (2026-02-12). Census restaurant sales (separate finding) points the same way for GPV.

findings.finding: The FY2026 recurring GP guide ($2,325-2,355M) less Q1 ($529M), Q2 ($595M) and the Q3 guide ($615-625M) implies Q4 of about $576-616M, midpoint about $596M. That is about +19% on Q4 2025's $502M, against 22-24% guided for Q3 and 27-28% delivered in H1. If Q3 beats by about $20M and Q4 run-rates normally, an FY raise of $20-40M (about 1-2%) is arithmetically likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name trades on the guide. Q1 2026: FY raised, but a weak next-quarter guide and hardware cost uncertainty took it -14.74%. Q2 2026: FY raised by less than the beat (tariff refund reinvested), +2.93%.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public, so a modest raise is expected. A raise beyond the Q3 beat, putting implied Q4 at 22%+, would surprise. If the market expected a large raise, the skew would not be +22 vol points to the downside. In Q2 management raised by less than the beat and said it reinvests upside, so a flow-through-only raise is the likely base case.
findings.independence: Shares the Q2 release with finding 1 (Q2 actuals); the Q4 2025 base of $502M comes from https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260212058106/en/Toast-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results. Same-document caveat: management reinvests upside (Q2 call, https://www.webull.com/news/15386954068485120).

findings.finding: US eating-and-drinking-place sales (Census, seasonally adjusted) were $92.9B in September 2026, +7.0% y/y nominal and +3.4% real. Per the National Restaurant Association these are the strongest gains in more than three and nearly four years, with real sales up six months running. That is a same-store GPV tailwind for Toast's fintech gross profit (payments about 50 bps of GPV) in Q3, after Q2 'strong same-store sales trends'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GPV per location drove the Q3 2023 slowdown narrative. No clean recent case where same-store GPV alone moved the stock; Q2 2026's +2.93% came with 'strong same-store' commentary.
findings.why_not_priced: A public macro series that sell-side can read, so partly priced. Transmission to Toast's SMB-weighted base is unconfirmed by the company. If priced as a sure GPV beat, the 20-day run-up would not sit next to a heavy put skew.
findings.independence: Proxy. Mixed counterparty data: Chipotle Q3 2026 comps +2.1% with 'low-single-digit headwinds' from July (10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001058090/000105809026000104/cmg-20260930.htm), which points softer for chains. Visa's July-September 2026 payments volume +9% constant dollar (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001403161/000140316126000126/q42026earningsrelease.htm) is broadly supportive.

findings.finding: On the Q2 2026 call the CFO said hardware memory-cost pressure will have a larger P&L impact in 2027 than 2026 ('I would expect the P&L impact in '27 to be greater than '26'). The FY2026 guide already absorbs about 150 bps from memory, mostly in H2. DRAM contract prices rose about 93-98% QoQ in Q1 2026 and were forecast +58-63% in Q2 2026 (TrendForce). Early 2027 commentary on this call could therefore weigh on the forward EBITDA view.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: hardware costs and tariff uncertainty were cited for the -14.74% reaction despite a beat. Q2 2026: CFO said the memory impact was already reduced against original expectations, stock +2.93%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the +22 vol-point put skew is consistent with the market fearing a forward-cost guide. What is not priced is the size of the 2027 hit, which management has not quantified. Offsetting: the CFO said 2026-27 memory impact was reduced against original expectations.
findings.independence: Memory 150 bps in the FY guide: https://quartr.com/events/toast-inc-tost-q4-2025_oj3myNn8 (Feb 2026). DRAM price path: https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260202-12911.html and https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260601-13070.html. Not company-confirmed for 2027 numbers.

findings.finding: Fiserv, owner of Clover and Toast's largest SMB POS competitor, reported Q3 2026 this morning (2026-11-03). Merchant Solutions GAAP revenue fell -3% ($2,521M against $2,586M), organic -2%, segment operating margin 28.7% against 37.2%, and a $6.45B goodwill impairment. The release gives no Clover growth figures ('consistent underlying growth' only). This is consistent with continued share availability for Toast's net adds (Q2 record about 9,500).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean case of Toast trading on a Clover print. Net adds were a record in Q2 2026 (+2.93% reaction).
findings.why_not_priced: Same-day release, hours before Toast prints, so only partly absorbed. Clover weakness has been a known theme since 2025, so the incremental read is small.
findings.independence: Clover Q2 2026 GPV +9% (+11% ex-conversion), from coverage cited in search https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/fiservs-earnings-call-strategic-moves-amid-challenges. Proxy: Toast net adds are not confirmed until the print.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-10, six days after the Q2 print, Adyen began backend acquiring for select Toast Payments accounts in the US, extending a partnership in place since 2021 elsewhere. That could lower Toast's processing cost and lift fintech gross margin from Q3, but scale and timing are undisclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Fintech net take rate went to 59 bps in Q2 2026 (+5 bps y/y total) and the stock rose +2.93%. No case of a processor change moving the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Toast has not quantified any economics, and 'select accounts' implies a slow ramp. A visible margin benefit on this call would be new.

findings.finding: CEO Aman Narang sold about 300,000 shares (about $10.6M) on 2026-08-05/06 under a Rule 10b5-1 plan through a charitable remainder trust. No open-market insider purchases in the 12 months to 2026-10-26; 6 insiders sold about $23.0M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None; plan sales are routine at this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and pre-planned, so effectively priced. Filed for completeness only.
findings.independence: Tracker summary of insider activity: https://new.quantisnow.com/insiders/TOST

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, which agrees with the +11.8% 20-day run-up but cuts against the +22 vol-point put skew. No document tells me the option market is wrong about this print, so p_up sits only slightly above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the Q1 2026 beat-and-raise was sold -14.7%, so the beat-pattern finding was cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Lesson 7 (sign against strong skew): +22 vol-point put skew and no document saying the market is wrong, so the guidance-raise finding was cut from +1.2 to +1.0 and p_up moved from 56 to 54.

Lesson 3/5 (own caveat; narrow proxy): Census restaurant sales is a broad public series but its transmission is unconfirmed and Chipotle's 10-Q cites headwinds, so it was cut from +0.8 to +0.6. The Fiserv read-through was cut from +0.4 to +0.3 as a proxy.
Lesson 7 (short interest before a negative): checked 5.9% of float and 3.7 days, not crowded, so the memory-cost negative stays at -1.0.

Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the bar is the company guide plus two agreeing revenue-consensus sources. Consensus recurring GP is unsourced and stated as such; the findings are already small, so no further cap.
Unchanged: abs_move_pct 10.5 (lesson 8 / core: do not shrink for sign uncertainty), Adyen, insider and BofA items.
